name: Mupen64Plus AE
tagline: Play Nintendo 64 games on your phone
description:
Mupen64Plus AE is the Android front end for Mupen64Plus, the long-running Nintendo 64 emulator. Open a game file you own and it plays on your phone, using on-screen buttons or a Bluetooth controller.

It has been around for years and is on F-Droid, so it updates along with your other apps. There is a forum for support and discussion when a particular game misbehaves.

No games come with it, and this is a community project rather than an official release from the Mupen64Plus team.
